question: Should this external PR add persistent Telegram group/topic UI override config and main-session cron no-delivery wake suppression together, once the metadata, proof, and conflict blockers are fixed?
rationale: The PR adds new user-facing config surface and changes cron wake/message semantics in one branch; that combination needs maintainer product intent after the technical blockers are resolved.

options.title: Refresh combined PR
options.body: Keep the Telegram and cron changes together only after the branch is rebased, generated metadata is refreshed, and both behaviors have redacted real proof.

options.title: Split cron behavior
options.body: Land the Telegram scoped UI override separately and move cron wake suppression into its own proof-focused PR.

options.title: Decline new config surface
options.body: Close or narrow the branch if maintainers do not want more persistent Telegram per-chat UI config.

recommendation.title: Refresh combined PR
recommendation.body: Keep the Telegram and cron changes together only after the branch is rebased, generated metadata is refreshed, and both behaviors have redacted real proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available routing candidate from current-line blame and adjacent scoped Telegram config merge history.
